sloka: स बद्ध इव पाशेन किशोरो मातरम् यथा ।धर्मपाशेन सम्क्षिप्तः प्रकाशम् नाभुदैक्षत ॥२-४०-४०॥
transliteration: sa baddha iva pāśena kiśoro mātaram yathā ।dharmapāśena samkṣiptaḥ prakāśam nābhudaikṣata ॥2-40-40॥

translations.english: Like a fastened foal cannot see its mother, Rama restrained by bonds of duty could not see his parents clearly.
